scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 5 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Betning yuqorisida gazeta uslubidagi sarlavha:
  kichik harflar bilan — 'AROUND THE CLOCK WITH'
  ostida chiziq, so'ng katta ko'k harflar bilan — 'Annie Franklin'

O'ng tomonda yosh ayolning yon tomondan olingan surati: uzun to'q sariq-jigarrang soch, tepaga yig'ilgan, yuzga tushgan bir necha tola, oq kiyim.

Chap tomonda 18 ta nuqtali qator, suratdan pastda esa butun bet kengligida yana 6 ta qator.

⚠ Yozuv maydoni BO'SH — kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN. Vazifa sarlavhadan tushuniladi: o'quvchi Anni Franklinning KUN TARTIBI haqida maqola yozadi.

⚠⚠ MUHIM KUZATUV: Photo File bo'limida UNIT 4 uchun varaq YO'Q. 3-unitning ikkinchi varag'idan keyin darrov 5-unit keladi. Bu — kitobning tuzilishi (xato emas): 4-unit mavzusi (o'yin-kulgi/qobiliyat) uchun rasm kerak bo'lmagan.

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 5 - AROUND THE CLOCK WITH Annie Franklin. Write about her daily routine.
exercises.instructionUz: 5-UNIT — ANNI FRANKLIN BILAN KUN BO'YI. Uning kun tartibi haqida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh VARAG'I.

  Sarlavha berilgan, surat berilgan,
  qolgan joy BO'Sh.

  ⚠ Kitob mashq matni BERMAGAN — vazifa
  SARLAVHAdan tushuniladi.


SARLAVHA:

     AROUND THE CLOCK WITH
     ─────────────────────
       Annie Franklin


⚠ 'AROUND THE CLOCK' NIMA DEGANI:

  So'zma-so'z: 'soat atrofida'
  Ma'nosi: KUN BO'YI, sutka davomida,
           ertalabdan kechgacha

  Ya'ni: 'Anni Franklin bilan bir kun'

  ⚠ Bu — jurnal maqolalarining odatiy
  sarlavhasi: mashhur odamning kuni
  soatma-soat tasvirlanadi.

  Boshqa misollar:
     'The shop is open around the clock.'
     = Do'kon kechayu kunduz ochiq.


SURATDA KIM:

  Yosh ayol, yon tomondan olingan surat.
  Uzun to'q sariq-jigarrang soch, tepaga
  yig'ilgan, yuziga bir necha tola tushgan.
  Oq kiyim.

  ⚠ 2-unit varag'ida ham odamlar suratlari
  bor edi, lekin u yerda TAShQI KO'RINIShNI
  tasvirlash kerak edi. Bu yerda esa
  KUN TARTIBINI yozish kerak.


NAMUNA MAQOLA:

──────────────────────────────────
  AROUND THE CLOCK WITH
     ANNIE FRANKLIN

  Annie Franklin is a famous singer.
  She is twenty-four years old and
  she lives in London.

  She gets up at half past six every
  morning. She has a shower and
  then she has breakfast.

  At eight o'clock she goes to the
  music studio. She practises for
  four hours.

  She has lunch at one o'clock. In
  the afternoon she meets her
  friends or goes shopping.

  In the evening she often gives
  concerts. She usually gets home
  late and goes to bed at midnight.

  'I love my job,' she says.
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ 5-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI — PRESENT SIMPLE:

  Kun tartibi HAR KUNGI ish — shuning
  uchun PRESENT SIMPLE ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDA '-S' QO'ShILADI:

     I get up   →  She getS up
     I go       →  She goeS
     I have     →  She HAS  (⚠ tartibsiz!)
     I watch    →  She watchES
     I study    →  She studIES

  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'She get up' ✗
                    'She getS up' ✓


⚠ VAQT PREDLOGLARI:

     AT + aniq soat
        at seven o'clock, at midnight

     IN + kun qismi
        in the morning, in the afternoon,
        in the evening

     ON + kun
        on Monday, on Sundays

  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night' ('in' EMAS!)


⚠ TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI:

     always     (100%)  — doim
     usually    (90%)   — odatda
     often      (70%)   — tez-tez
     sometimes  (50%)   — ba'zan
     never      (0%)    — hech qachon

  ⚠ O'RNI: ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN
     'She USUALLY gets up early.'  ✓
     'She gets up usually early.'  ✗

  ⚠ LEKIN 'BE' dan KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'  ✓


MAQOLANI QANDAY YOZISh:

  1) TANIShTIRISh — kim u, nechchi yoshda,
     qayerda yashaydi, kasbi nima
  2) ERTALAB — gets up, has a shower,
     has breakfast
  3) KUNDUZI — goes to work, works,
     has lunch
  4) KEChQURUN — gets home, watches TV,
     goes to bed
  5) IQTIBOS — 'I love my job,' she says.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  around the clock = kun bo'yi, sutka davomida
  a daily routine  = kun tartibi
  to get up        = uyg'onmoq, turmoq
  to have a shower = dush qabul qilmoq
  to practise      = mashq qilmoq
  to give a concert = konsert bermoq
  midnight         = yarim tun
  midday / noon    = tush payti
  famous           = mashhur

'in'.

'She usually gets' ✓ / 'She gets usually' ✗

'midnight' = yarim tun (00:00);
'midday' / 'noon' = tush (12:00).
